verdict.rationale: The evidence implies official client SDKs but never documents them directly. A JavaScript language guide exists, and the docs describe filtering sensitive data in your application before errors are sent to Raygun. dSYM and ProGuard uploads point to iOS and Android clients, and a long-time user praises Raygun's .NET and WinRT support. Missing for 10: an explicit list or docs of official SDKs by language, SDK API reference and install instructions, an OpenAPI spec (probe 404) for generated clients, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
